summary: CSB Financial Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an Agency Agreement with Performance Trust Capital Partners for a best-efforts stock offering in connection with the mutual-to-stock conversion of its bank subsidiary. The agreement outlines success fees based on subscription and community offering proceeds, a management fee, and expense reimbursements. The offering is conducted under a Form S-1 registration statement. This is a routine capital-formation step in a mutual conversion, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, tender, or activist element; the filing is a standard disclosure of a material definitive agreement related to an equity offering.
